sections.narration: Your laptop is brilliant. But some problems would take it longer than the age of the universe.
sections.direction: Confident open, slight lift on 'age of the universe'.

sections.narration: That's because a normal computer thinks in bits. Every bit is either a zero or a one. One definite answer, checked one at a time.
A quantum computer uses qubits. A qubit can hold zero and one at the same time, and link with others, so possibilities are explored together.
sections.direction: Build energy. Emphasis on 'at the same time'.

sections.narration: The right algorithm cancels wrong answers and amplifies right ones. That could crack chemistry, new materials, and impossible logistics.
Not a faster laptop. A different kind of machine.
